text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: spike in 5xx rates from inference-gateway via envoy-lb routes detected (source: telemetry.rule.envoy5xx). Rolling page to oncall. link: https://internal.ops/alerts/5360001111 :rotating_light:

maya (oncall): taking this. seeing a big jump in 5xx around ~14:08 UTC across several frontend routes, p50 stable but p95 latency up.

maya (oncall): metrics snapshot: global 5xx from 0.15% -> 7.9% in 3m, gateway timeouts (504) and upstream reset (502) dominate. Top affected route: /v1/generate -> backend pool inference-shard-14.

simon (infra-sre): adding logs from envoy for the shard, lots of `upstream_reset` and `reset reason: connection failure`. Config change? I see a rollout at ~13:57 by deploy-bot: `rollout envoy-route-weighting v2`

deploy-bot: deploy finished: rollout-id=deploy-2026-03-15-1357, target=envoy-route-weighting, author=@kevin (prodops).

arjun (eng-runtime): recalling that rollout -- it adjusted retry policy and circuit-breaker thresholds for some routes (increasing retry attempts and lowering max connections per-host). That could produce overload cascades.

maya (oncall): hypothesis: increased retries + tighter CB caused request fanout and upstream overload -> 5xx cascade. Quick mitigation: disable retries at the gateway for /v1/generate and restore previous CB thresholds.

simon (infra-sre): agree. Applying runtime patch now: `envoy runtime override set routes.v1.generate.retries 0` and `routes.v1.generate.circuit_breakers.max_connections 0` (0 = unset / fallback to node default) -- doing staged patch to half of edge fleet.

maya (oncall): staging patch across 50% of LB nodes. monitoring for impact.

liz (support-lead): notifying SRE queue and Support-runbook; prepping quick PS update for impacted accounts. Which customers are hitting this hard?

eva-cs: internal list - three enterprise customers showing elevated error rates (cust-a, cust-b, cust-c). cust-a has high volume and sees 30% requests failing intermittently.

simon (infra-sre): after the staged patch: 5xx dropped to 3.1% on patched nodes but unpatched remain ~8.2%. Rolling patch to 100% now.

maya (oncall): rolling to 100%. also bumping route weight away from inference-shard-14 by shifting 30% to healthy pool (weight update via control plane). Command: `rctl route modify /v1/generate set-weight inference-shard-14 70 inference-shard-12 30`

arjun (eng-runtime): deployed weight shift. running smoke `curl` against a few endpoints to validate: `for i in 1..5; do curl -sI https://api.redwood/v1/generate | head -n1; done`

maya (oncall): smoke looks cleaner. 200s now, p95 latency improving. metrics: global 5xx -> 0.9% within 4m of full roll.

kevin (prodops): what about the config rollback? we should revert the earlier rollout for retries/CB to be safe and then re-audit the tuning separately.

arjun (eng-runtime): scheduling a rollback of the specific rollout: `rollout revert deploy-2026-03-15-1357` to ensure we don't flip-flop. Revert will keep other unrelated changes. Kicking it off now.

deploy-bot: revert started for rollout-id=deploy-2026-03-15-1357, stage=1/3.

maya (oncall): handoff: I'm going to monitor for 30m for any regression, then hand to simon for long-running deep-dive. ETA for handoff ~15:10 UTC.

liz (support-lead): crafting customer message: short summary, impact (increased 5xx and timeouts affecting generation endpoints for some customers), mitigation (rolled back route retry/CB tuning, disabled retries, shifted traffic off affected shard), expected follow-up (postmortem). Drafting now, will post to status page once simon confirms stability.

simon (infra-sre): revert completed, control-plane confirms config consistent across fleet. post-revert checks show 5xx ~0.35% and error logs dropping. I'll take over and run deeper validation: review telemetry for skewed host CPU/queue lengths, per-shard connection counts, and recent config diffs.

arjun (eng-runtime): preliminary root-cause notes: the change increased retry attempts from 1->3 while reducing per-host connection threshold which allowed retries to amplify load while CBs tripped earlier, concentrating traffic on fewer hosts and causing upstream resets. Need to add safety guard in rollout (alert if 5xx > 1% within 5m).

maya (oncall): handing off to simon now. I will remain reachable for escalation.

simon (infra-sre): taking the incident. next steps: correlate client retry patterns, check any application-side SDK changes, run a canary test harness to re-introduce safe retry (1) and relaxed CB slightly, but gated. Planning a postmortem and action items: 1) add rollout guardrail, 2) improve canary size/perf checks, 3) revise default CB/retry matrix per route.

liz (support-lead): sent PS draft to oncall for review. tagging @product-ops for customer comms approval.

kevin (prodops): thanks all. Quick note for status: severity=sev2 (service degradation for subset of customers), impact window ~14:08-14:28 UTC, mitigation applied by 14:18 UTC, errors near baseline by 14:24 UTC.

eva-cs: notified account teams for cust-a/b/c and started bridge with cust-a engineering. They acknowledged and will monitor.

simon (infra-sre): logging final checklist: revert recorded, retries disabled, traffic redistributed, monitoring alert threshold adjusted. Will open follow-up ticket with timeline and config diff.

maya (oncall): closing active paging. If any regression, re-ping on this thread or page oncall. :white_check_mark:
